title: Crestline Companion Fare Refund Amount on a Cancelled Booking
content:
**Clause.** Under Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, the refund of the companion fare of a cancelled booking is the amount of the most recent companion fare charge on the certificate, refunded in full with no cancellation retention.

## Quantities

- **Most recent companion fare charge on the certificate** — the charge entry of component companion fare with the latest entry date in the trip and charge history of the certificate or pass the booking was made on.
- **Final cancellation retention** — the retention multiplied by the booking-count factor and then by one minus the combined waiver percentage, rounded half up to the cent once at that point. The waiver percentages are first added into one combined waiver percentage, which is applied once to the scaled retention, never one after the other.
- **Companion fare refund** — the most recent companion fare charge on the certificate less the final cancellation retention, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

| Input or step | Value |
|---|---|
| Most recent companion fare charge on the certificate | 119.00 USD |
| Cancellation retention | none |
| Companion fare refund | 119.00 USD, refunded in full |

## Basis Q&A

**Which charge is refunded when the certificate carries more than one companion fare charge?** The amount is read from the most recent companion fare charge on the certificate, the one with the latest entry date.

**Can the refund be negative?** No. The refund is never below zero.

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
